claim_limit: Strict 24-row preparation matrix. Three canonical N=1000 source blocks cross short/long compiled layouts with accelerator Stage1/Stage2 RR, II, IR and RI fields. The 16 ideal-source rows use explicit zero RF-period pulse policy; the eight canonical real-octupole rows freeze the detector-blind pulse policy at +0.0625 RF periods (695 eligible particles in the established selector receipt). All rows use the native one-row surface=none grid renderer, z=0.05 mm accelerator overlay, Formal 0.25/1.0 mm oaTOF mesh, trajectory quality 8, RF160 canonical instrument clock, and the same verified real reflectron PA family/build geometry; each layout retains its own theory-matched compiled reflectron voltages. Rows are executable individually through the existing ExperimentId boundary. No solver result or resolution claim is made by this campaign.
